standard: GDD rework v2 · 80+ researched scenarios · scorecard-passed
note: Peer pressure, decisions & feelings (UNESCO 1.x, 5.1-5.3, 7.1). New v2 build, Chapter 3 (matter-of-fact, near-peer). The branching-dilemma signature game. Builds on g09; prereq g15.
evidenceBase: Good decisions: stop and think (pause/breathe), see several options (not black-and-white), then ask 'what might happen if I choose this?' for both good and bad outcomes
Think ahead to the bigger picture and decide by your values and goals, not impulse or pressure
Practise with real dilemmas and pros/cons; owning and learning from choices builds judgement
